summary: Two churches, Holy Spirit (Webster) and St. Joseph's (Penfield). The weekend, weekday, Confession and daily Holy Spirit Adoration times agree in the three readable bulletins. A dated Relic Tour Mass at St. Joseph's on Oct 28 is included. Open: whether the Friday 8 PM Holy Hour, which sits inside the Friday Adoration hours, gets its own slot.
